correctness.rationale: All lengths \(n\ge3\): one descent forces two strictly increasing contiguous blocks. Exhaustive classification of the three local swaps, including two endpoint-only central-swap cases, forces exactly the (j,t) templates for every nonisolated state. Explicit swaps connect consecutive t; the local criterion forbids chords, and the invariant ordering of consecutive VALUES separates distinct j. Eulerian counting yields isolated multiplicity, degree and edge counts. Standalone exhaustive checker.py replay from actual package verifies full graphs \(3\le n\le9\) and 783 ordered path distances \(3\le n\le8\). Finite checks are not used as proof of n-uniformity; boundary n=2 is isolated.

value.rationale: The level set of exactly one Eulerian descent is a natural constrained permutation space for Gray-code generation and locally constrained sampling. A complete all-n graph decomposition establishes exact feasible reachability and optimal routes, the entire degree spectrum, sharp maximum mobile-component diameter and exponential rarity of movable states. It reveals a structural failure of simple descent-preserving adjacent-swap sampling; the fact is more than the already known Eulerian count or identical scalar integer sequence.
